Title: I would love to organize a demo...

Messages.Author: xXLazarusXx
Messages.Body:
Hello there!
I recently moved to Lodi, Ca and am trying to start up a play group. I know there are players in the woodworks here and its just an issue of making things happen. I frequent the local game store (The Launchpad) and run a cWoD Chronicle there on Thursdays. So getting myself a timeslot and advertising isn't an issue.
I was inquiring about becoming a demo organizer of sorts.
Let me know what's going on and thanks for reading this!!!

Prince of Lodi, Ca
Everyone must ride with Charon, by and by. We merely wish to know what to ask him before we step onto his boat.

Messages.Author: Lönkka
